name: flat_walking_very_strong_end_stops
description: Flat floor, walking speeds 0.2 to 0.7 m/s, and a large cost for resting joints on their end stops
notes: Duck 4's fifth run (from_run_4). End stop weight 0.2, four times flat_walking_end_stops: at 0.1 only his ankles and toes left their stops, while the neck, hip swings and hip sides stayed on theirs about 95% of the time. In that posture (about 6.5 joints at their stops) this costs about 1.3 points per step, more than walking earns at most speeds, so staying crouched now loses points: he must leave the stops, or he may learn to fall on purpose (watch the falls).
